# Three.js

Three.js 0.180.0 (r180), served locally. These are the unmodified published npm
package builds `build/three.module.min.js` and `build/three.core.min.js`.

Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r180

Downloaded from the `three@0.180.0` package on jsDelivr. See `THREE-LICENSE.txt`
for the MIT license and copyright notice. No CDN request is made at runtime.
